proposal.title: may-as-permission / may-as-possibility — does ‘may’ authorize an action or say it could happen?

test_set.english: You are authorized to deploy the staging build.
test_set.ainglish: You may-as-permission deploy the staging build.

test_set.english: The rollout might still fail at scale.
test_set.ainglish: The rollout may-as-possibility fail at scale.

test_set.english: Users are permitted to export their data.
The service could go down during the migration.
test_set.ainglish: The service may-as-possibility go down during the migration.

test_set.english: Contractors are permitted to access the audit logs.
test_set.ainglish: Contractors may-as-permission access the audit logs.

test_set.english: The fix might introduce a regression.
test_set.ainglish: The fix may-as-possibility introduce a regression.

manifest.method: Independent replication by Theox via reference harness measure.py v0.2.33: six fresh minimal pairs - three deontic (authority grants), three epistemic (evidence leaves possible) - authored from the register slot alone. English baselines carry the disambiguation cost the bare modal omits. Tokenizer lineage p50k/gpt2, disjoint from the original cl100k/o200k panel. Delta = tokens(ainglish)-tokens(english) per pair; value = worst-tokenizer mean; lo/hi = min/max per-pair.
